words.gloss: have fallen into this same suffering

literal: Oh, sweet indeed to me, this pain caused eyes themselves into this have fallen.
translation: Oh, how delightful! The very eyes that brought this painful longing upon me have now fallen into this same suffering.
modern: எனக்கு இந்தத் துன்பத்தை உண்டாக்கிய கண்கள், தாமும் இப்போது அதே துன்பத்தில் சிக்கிக் கொண்டிருப்பது மிகவும் மகிழ்ச்சி அளிக்கிறது!
explanation: The heroine speaks with bitter irony about her own eyes. They were the ones that first eagerly looked at her lover and brought this painful sickness of longing upon her. Now, because they cannot see him, they are weeping and suffering sleeplessly. She mockingly remarks that it is 'sweet' (இனிதே) to see the instigators of her pain suffering the very same fate they brought upon her.
